data.description:
If the diagnostic mode is {@link FailureModeEvaluationMode#SENSOR_BASED},
data represents the measurement data from the sensor.
If the diagnostic mode is {@link FailureModeEvaluationMode#RESIDUAL_BASED},
data represents residual / sensor measurement

expectedSensor.description: {@link data} comes from a sensor linked with this {@link ExpectedSensor}
